artifacts.name: mcp_json_rpc_bridge
artifacts.summary: A tool designed to manage the lifecycle and JSON-RPC communication with the `notebooklm-mcp` subprocess, ensuring parameter names like `notebook_id` and `query` are correctly aligned [1].

artifacts.name: sidecar_metadata_manager
artifacts.summary: A utility to generate and maintain JSON metadata files that reside alongside materialized code drafts to store summaries and prevent brittle parsing of source files [2, 3].

artifacts.name: synchronized_index_enforcer
artifacts.summary: A tool that implements blocking wait-states and timeouts (e.g., `wait=True`) during source addition to ensure content is fully indexed before a RAG query is executed [1].

artifacts.name: hybrid_mcp_scaffolding
artifacts.summary: Proficiency in scaffolding hybrid architectures that pivot dependency stacks from HTTP wrappers to stdio-based MCP servers [1].

artifacts.name: regex_proposal_parsing
artifacts.summary: The ability to use regex-based anchors on names to accurately extract structured proposals even when summary fields contain conflicting characters like pipes [2, 3].

artifacts.name: venv_path_resolution
artifacts.summary: The ability to dynamically resolve CLI paths using `sys.executable` to ensure background processes always run within the intended virtual environment [1].

artifacts.name: Architecture_Integrity_Maintainer
artifacts.summary: An agent focused on resolving circular imports and maintaining directory structures when shifting RAG pipelines to native subprocess models [1].

artifacts.name: Artifact_Lifecycle_Guardian
artifacts.summary: An agent dedicated to the coordinated approval and rejection of artifacts, ensuring that both primary code files and their associated sidecar JSON metadata are cleaned up or moved together [2, 3].

artifacts.name: Session_Persistence_Coordinator
artifacts.summary: An agent responsible for loading the last session from disk and managing in-memory deduplication to prevent duplicate proposals across runs [1, 3].
